people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
translations.bsb: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
translations.kjv: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
translations.asv: And Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
